```artifact
Feature: Patient History File and System Performance

  Scenario: Retrieve patient history for the last 3 years
    Given a patient with ID "P001"
    When the system retrieves the patient's history for the last 3 years
    Then the system should return a list of consultations
    And the list should contain at least one consultation

  Scenario: Scale system to handle 10,000+ concurrent users
    Given the system is under load with 10,000 concurrent users
    When the system handles the load
    Then the system should remain stable and responsive

  Scenario: Patient registration should complete within 4 seconds
    Given a new patient with valid information
    When the system registers the patient
    Then the registration should complete within 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient consultation requests should complete within 2 seconds
    Given a patient with a consultation request
    When the system processes the consultation request
    Then the request should complete within 2 seconds

  Scenario: Chemist prescription requests should complete within 2 seconds
    Given a chemist with a prescription request
    When the system processes the prescription request
    Then the request should complete within 2 seconds

  Scenario: Labs lab requests should complete within 4 seconds
    Given a lab with a lab request
    When the system processes the lab request
    Then the request should complete within 4 seconds

  Scenario: Patient prescription and invoice look-up should complete within 4 seconds
    Given a patient with a prescription and invoice look-up request
    When the system processes the request
    Then the request should complete within 4 seconds
```
